# use of subprocess/git without isolation can cause runtime failures

The test fixture invokes git via subprocess calls (git init, add, commit, mv, rm, rev-parse). If git is missing, misconfigured, or a command fails, those subprocess calls raise exceptions and the tests will fail; there is no retry/isolation around these external commands.

**Anchored to:**

- `tests/test_incremental.py` — `tests.test_incremental.git`
- `tests/test_incremental.py` — `tests.test_incremental.env`
